title: Musical on Ice — full-length musicals on ice

hero.lede: Full-length musicals on ice: live vocals, orchestral scores and world-class skaters.
hero.where: 12 December to 8 February in Bali, Indonesia.

about.heading: Musicals on ice that tour the world
about.statement: Musical on Ice is five full-length productions on ice: live vocals, orchestral music, arena-wide projections and skaters of international standard.
about.text: We bring the whole show with us: lighting, sound, costumes, sets and the company. The venue provides the ice. Over ten years our productions have played to audiences in Italy, Ireland, Germany, Bulgaria, Latvia, Lithuania, Slovakia and China.

shows.heading: Our shows
shows.intro: Five productions on ice, from a family fairy tale to a gothic drama. Pick a show to see what it is about.

items.title: Aladdin
items.text: Aladdin and other famous stories from 1001 Nights on ice: an Eastern city, a genie and a dance over a frozen lake.
items.about:
An Eastern fairy tale on ice: the bazaars of Baghdad, the Sultan’s palace and the lamp that releases the genie.

The show features skaters of international standard, live vocals and arena-wide video projection. Alongside Aladdin’s story it weaves in other tales from 1001 Nights.
items.lead: An Eastern fairy tale on ice, with a genie, a flying carpet and a city of a thousand lights.

items.title: Alice in Wonderland
items.text: A family show after Lewis Carroll: the Mad Hatter, the White Rabbit and an icy tunnel into Wonderland.
items.about:
Carroll’s Alice falls down the rabbit hole and lands in a Wonderland made of ice.

The show has toured Italy, Ireland, Germany, Bulgaria, Latvia, Lithuania, Slovakia, China and beyond. A true family production that children and adults enjoy equally.
items.lead: The rabbit hole leads onto the ice: the Mad Hatter, the White Rabbit and a Wonderland that fills the whole arena.

items.title: Dracula
items.text: The story of eternal love: a castle under a full moon, gothic drama and the darkest lighting of all our productions.
items.about:
A story of eternal love told on skates: a castle under a full moon, bats and blood-red light.

Our darkest production, made for teenagers and adults. Gothic music, demanding lifts and a finale we ask you not to spoil.
items.lead: A story of eternal love told on skates. The darkest of our productions.

items.title: The Little Prince
items.text: A fantastical performance after Saint-Exupéry: a starry sky, a single rose and a great deal of empty ice.
items.about:
A quiet performance after Saint-Exupéry: an asteroid, a rose, a fox and a man who has forgotten how to see with his heart.

The ice is almost empty, and that is deliberate. The starry sky is created by projection, and the whole story rests on one performer and a handful of objects.
items.lead: A starry sky, a single rose and a man who forgot how to see with his heart.

items.title: Princess Anastasia
items.text: The secret heir to the throne: imperial St Petersburg, revolution and a melodrama with live vocals.
items.about:
The secret heir to the throne: imperial St Petersburg, revolution and the fate of the last Tsar’s youngest daughter.

A historical melodrama with live vocals, ballroom scenes and a finale set against the Winter Palace.
items.lead: Imperial St Petersburg, revolution and the fate of the last Tsar’s youngest daughter.

piano.heading: The piano itself
piano.intro: In the first act the ice belongs to one skater and a piano. The instrument below is real: press a key with your mouse, your finger or your computer keyboard. The letters are printed on the keys.
piano.hint: Sound plays only when you press a key.

dates.heading: Dates and tickets
dates.intro: The first three rows by the boards give the best view of both the ice and the orchestra.

footer.note: Flash photography and filming are not allowed: the light distracts performers during lifts, and the vocals are live.
